name: ModelVariant799_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant799_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (up to six bolts leave a model point at their own start times and fly towards a jittered point on the opposing slot, shedding two sets of debris particles and flaring into glows on arrival while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the bolts and debris and packs seven texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the first start time, 4 once as each of the first five bolts arrives, 1 once when the last bolt arrives, 2 once the last glow has faded after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-816 and 913 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
